responsibility: Implements the standalone lto-wrapper driver invoked by collect2 or the linker plugin to orchestrate GCC’s link-time optimization pipeline. It reconstructs decoded options from COLLECT_GCC_OPTIONS, merges and filters LTO-related command-line state, determines whether to run regular LTO or WHOPR/LTRANS, manages temporary files, invokes the compiler and optional parallel make-based LTRANS jobs, handles jobserver integration, and prints the resulting output object paths for the linker. This file is the process-control and option-merging front end for LTO execution, not part of the IL streamer itself.
